cards.entity: Series power storage dual voltage power supply device
cards.claim: The Series power storage dual voltage power supply device was involved in the demolition of the MV Serenity.
cards.quote: Its once-proud hull now rusted and battered, the ship was slated for demolition, its valuable components to be salvaged and recycled. Rizwan's team had been hired to do the job, and he was determined to get it done quickly and efficiently. As he made his way onto the ship, Rizwan's thoughts turned to the peculiar request from the ship's owner, a reclusive billionaire with a penchant for cutting-edge technology. The old man had insisted that a specialized power supply device be installed on the ship, one capable of handling dual voltage outputs. Rizwan had raised an eyebrow at the time, but the promise of a hefty bonus had convinced him to comply. Now, as he navigated the ship's cramped corridors, Rizwan caught glimpses of the device in question, its sleek metal casing emblazoned with the logo of a company called NovaTech. The Series power storage dual voltage power supply device, as it was called, seemed to be humming along smoothly, its LED lights blinking like a chorus of fireflies as it fed power to the ship's systems.
